title: Green Gables Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: Green Gables is a 1.00 bedroom, 1.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Welcome to Green GablesTucked along picturesque Forest Street, Green Gables is a classic Seaside, Florida home offering charm, privacy, and a highly walkable location. Just a short stroll from Seaside Avenue, the family park, and the community pool—and only a 5-minute walk to beach access and the Seaside Amphitheater—this inviting retreat places more than 35 shops and restaurants right outside your door.A Private Cottage Setting Surrounded by NatureGuests arrive via a private parking area and are welcomed by the home’s cheerful green exterior, framed by mature trees and lush landscaping that create a peaceful, secluded feel. A private entrance leads to a furnished screened porch, thoughtfully designed with lounge seating for two, dual-facing benches, and a ceiling fan. Positioned between shaded front and back yards, this porch is the perfect place to enjoy morning coffee or unwind after a sun-filled day at the beach.The backyard continues the serene atmosphere with towering trees, an outdoor shower, and a walkway that connects the first-level bedroom to the footpath behind the home.First-Floor Bedroom and BathInside on the first level, the queen bedroom is located just off the entry and features a cozy window seat, flat-screen TV, ample storage, and double doors opening directly to the backyard. A nearby full bathroom includes a single vanity and walk-in shower, offering convenience and comfort for guests.Open-Concept Living on the Second FloorUpstairs, the bright and airy second level showcases high ceilings and an inviting living area with comfortable seating and a flat-screen TV. Just off the living space, a private Juliette balcony overlooks the backyard, adding natural light and fresh air to the space.The adjacent dining area seats three and flows into a fully equipped kitchen featuring a four-burner electric stove and oven, microwave, dishwasher, coffee maker, toaster, and under-counter refrigerator—perfect for preparing meals after a day exploring Seaside. An additional Juliette balcony off the kitchen looks out onto quiet Forest Street, completing the home’s charming coastal feel.Your Seaside EscapeWith its classic design, tranquil surroundings, and unbeatable location near the heart of Seaside, Green Gables is an ideal coastal escape for couples or small families looking to experience the very best of Seaside, Florida.* 3 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2 night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURES624 square feetPrivate Seaside residential beach at East Ruskin PavilionSeaside is the largest private residential beach on 30A352 yards or a 5-minute walk to beach accessVery private lot, separate from the main homeAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts & 3 Pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities provided1 parking pass for one-bedroom homes issued. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permitNo pets allowed
